# voice-likeness-eval

Measure how much a cloned voice sounds like the real character, and whether a change really helped: ECAPA speaker-embedding similarity against the centroid of 60 held-out real clips, Whisper word error rate, per-line paired t-tests over 10 test lines, enough runs to beat sampling noise, a take-picker checked with an independent speaker model (ECAPA vs WavLM), and picking strategies simulated on 100 scored takes before one is deployed.
